title: With active and inactive matches, the active part's number is named
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919), with 'Part Library & Inventory → View / Create & Edit / Delete' and See Financial Data.
  • You can switch to a second location, {Location-B} (for example Staging Lethbridge - 4310), in the location switcher in the top bar.
  • Active part {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-BOTH-01) is stocked at {Location-A}.
  • Inactive part {Part-B} (for example ZZAUTOTESTPLBOTH01) is also stocked at {Location-A}, on its own Part Library entry, and its number matches {Part-A} once upper and lower case, hyphens, asterisks, periods and spaces are ignored.
  • The number you will type, {Number-A} (for example zz autotest pl both 01), matches both once upper and lower case, hyphens, asterisks, periods and spaces are ignored.
custom_steps:
1. At {Location-A}, go to Parts → Inventory, stay on the Active tab and click New Inventory Part.
  2. Type a Description (for example ZZAUTOTEST PL Both Try).
  3. Type {Number-A} in Part Number.
  4. Pick any Category (for example Uncategorized).
  5. Type a Cost (for example 10.00).
  6. Click Save.
  7. Click Cancel.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 6: the part is not saved. The red message is the one for an active part and names the active part's number: "{Part-A} already exists at this location." A second, smaller line reads "Please try to resolve this." It is not the message "{Part-B} already exists at this location and is inactive. Activate it from the Inactive tab.", and it does not name {Part-B}.
  • Step 7: the window closes.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10820 (Story 7, Create a Part by Typing Its Number and Description); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, as edited 9 Oct 2026 (Ready for dev), S7-N5a, S7-N3, S7-N5, §2 Out of scope (parts CSV import matching), §8 User Feedback Summary, read 13 Oct 2026; design canvas board 1.5 (The same number again, in lower case), 13 Oct copy. Product's 9 Oct answer (Chris Ward, question 4). Source-verified 13 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S7-N5a: “If the location stocks both an active and an inactive part with that number, the save is refused with the message of S7-N3. The message names the active part's number.”
  • S7-N3: “If a part with the same number is already stocked at this location and is active, the save is refused with "{part number} already exists at this location."”
  • S7-N5: “For S7-N3 and S7-N4, "the same number" ignores upper and lower case, hyphens, asterisks, periods, spaces and other blank characters. The message names the number of the part already there.”
  • PRD §8 User Feedback Summary (New part's number already stocked here, active): “"{part number} already exists at this location." | Error toast, fades after 3 seconds”
  • PRD §2 Out of scope (parts CSV import matching): “The import matches a number ignoring upper and lower case. If nothing matches, it also ignores hyphens, asterisks, periods and spaces. It writes the row's description onto the entry it matches. It never moves a part to a different entry and never changes an entry's part number (S13-N9).”
